title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Swing Billing Standard
content:
This standard governs how Commercial Natural Gas Supply bills usage against the monthly contract volume on plans that bill swing. Each plan's swing terms (whether swing is billed, its swing tolerance, its excess adder, its shortfall charge and its portfolio bandwidth term) are read from that plan's own row of the plan schedule.

## Clauses in force

**S1 — Monthly contract volume.** On a plan that bills swing, the monthly contract volume is the contracted annual therms divided by 12, the number of months in a year, and rounded half up to a whole therm, as the plan's monthly volume basis states.

**S2 — Usage inside the band.** Usage inside the band is billed entirely on the energy charge line at the fixed price.

**S3 — Plans without swing.** On plans that do not bill swing, all usage is billed on the energy charge line.

## Withdrawn wording

The following clauses of this standard are **no longer in force**. They have been superseded by the current basis and are recorded here only so that the withdrawn wording is recognised; none of them may be applied.

- *Withdrawn:* "The band runs from the monthly volume times (100 minus the swing tolerance) percent to the monthly volume times (100 plus the swing tolerance) percent, each rounded half up to a whole therm, both ends inclusive."
- *Withdrawn:* "Therms above the upper end are billed on a swing excess charge line at the month's index price plus the plan's swing excess adder, and the energy line bills only the upper-end therms."
- *Withdrawn:* "When usage is below the lower end, all usage is billed on the energy line and the shortfall therms are billed on a swing shortfall charge line at the plan's swing shortfall charge."

## Illustration of S1 (hypothetical contract volumes)

| Contracted annual therms | Divided by 12 | Monthly contract volume |
|---|---|---|
| 18,000 | 1,500.00 | 1,500 therms |
| 18,006 | 1,500.50 | 1,501 therms |
| 17,994 | 1,499.50 | 1,500 therms |
| 17,993 | 1,499.42 | 1,499 therms |

## Basis questions

**On the Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Monthly Index plan, is any usage billed on a swing line?** No. That plan does not bill swing, so under S3 all usage is billed on the energy charge line.

**Where do a plan's tolerance and swing charges come from?** From that plan's own terms in the plan schedule; each plan carries its own values.

superseded_clauses: The band runs from the monthly volume times (100 minus swing_tolerance_pct) percent to the monthly volume times (100 plus swing_tolerance_pct) percent, each rounded half up to a whole therm, both ends inclusive.
Therms above the upper end are billed on a swing_excess_charge line at the month's index_price_usd_therm plus swing_excess_adder_usd_therm, and the energy line bills only the upper-end therms.
When usage is below the lower end, all usage is billed on the energy line and the shortfall therms are billed on a swing_shortfall_charge line at swing_shortfall_charge_usd_therm.
